w3c_prov.purpose: Represent entities, activities, agents, derivation, use, generation and responsibility.

openlineage.purpose: Represent bounded runs, jobs, inputs, outputs and custom epistemic facets.

slsa_provenance.target: in-toto Statement with SLSA provenance predicate shape
slsa_provenance.purpose: Represent source subjects, resolved dependencies, builder identity and invocation boundary without claiming a signed attestation.

spdx.purpose: Represent repositories, artifacts and dependency relationships as a bounded materials inventory.

nist_ai_rmf.purpose: Relate RAFAELIA governance and evidence gates to risk-management functions without asserting certification.

vocabulary.semantics: Versioned epistemic work unit whose later review preserves the prior state and records a delta.
Atomic assertion with domain, assumptions, uncertainty, falsifier and four independent state axes.
Repository path, dataset, document, commit, artifact or observation from which a claim is derived.
Bounded transformation from definition or contract into code, configuration or executable procedure.
Reproducible procedure that evaluates a declared obligation without silently widening its domain.
Artifact, log, result, hash, measurement or receipt produced by an identified activity.
Gate evaluation that may preserve, block, promote structurally or revert a state.
Restoration of a known-good operational or epistemic state while preserving the evidence that caused reversal.
A required position is known, but the evidence needed to fill it has not been obtained; it is neither zero, null, false, pass nor fail.
Evidence or conditions conflict with an assertion; the conflicting record remains visible and versioned.
Predeclared observation, threshold or counterexample capable of blocking or changing a claim state.
Explicit unresolved obligation with owner, next action and exit criteria.
Repository, organization, person or service responsible for defining, executing, testing, interpreting or guarding a local truth boundary.
Versioned output with identity, digest, producer, conditions and bounded interpretation.
Device, ABI, environment, compiler, flags, model, tokenizer and parameter set needed to interpret execution evidence.

relation_semantics.rule: A claim or artifact may be derived from a source only when source identity and transformation are recorded.
Code implements a method or experiment; code alone does not close a gap.
An activity produces evidence; the evidence may close or preserve a gap according to a separate decision.
Semantic or symbolic similarity cannot be promoted into scientific, physical, legal or runtime evidence.
A newer state may supersede an older state without deleting the older evidence or its validity interval.

promotion_rules.condition: source_status does not imply epistemic_status, operational_status or claim_gate
TOKEN_VAZIO cannot be coerced to numeric, null, false, success or confidence
runtime claim requires artifact, device, ABI and environment evidence
failure, contradiction and unfavorable result remain versioned assets
SLSA-shaped projection without signer and verified builder remains TOKEN_VAZIO for attestation
